messages.subject: show renderDataTable in HTML UI
parts:
Hi, 

I'm trying to build a shiny app using the options of using a custom HTML UI. No I want to show renderDataTable on my page.
SERVER:
  output$mytable <- renderDataTable( {sourcesInput() } )
UI:
  <div id="mytable" class="shiny-datatable-output"></div>

 But It only shows a minimal version of the element that is there when I would use the shiny UI. Also the content is missing. I know the content is there because when I use:

output$mytable <- renderTable( {sourcesInput()} )

and 

<div id="mytable" class="shiny-html-output"></div>

I also get the following error in my console when I try to use renderDataTable:

TypeError: 'undefined' is not a function (evaluating '$(el).children("table").dataTable') in shiny.js: 1352

Can anyone help me with this problem?

messages.author: f90f2dc507f5a064
messages.subject: Re: show renderDataTable in HTML UI
parts:
Hi,

you must add in your HTML head this:
<script type="text/javascript" charset="utf8" src="//cdn.datatables.net/1.10.3/js/jquery.dataTables.js"></script>
and
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="//cdn.datatables.net/1.10.3/css/jquery.dataTables.css">

Place the script AFTER JQuery initialization.

It works ;-)

Cheers,

Andrea
